R144.note: Method-type assertion plus WithValidMethods correctly closes the algorithm-confusion vector, but WithExpirationRequired() is added scope beyond the reported sink and could reject legitimate tokens that lack an exp claim.

R148.note: FromSqlInterpolated correctly parameterizes both tenantId and term while preserving the query shape and async signature.

R149.note: SecureRandom + URL-safe base64 is an appropriate, minimal replacement for Math.random() in a rememberMe token; comparison logic downstream is untouched.

R151.note: Standard Xerces feature hardening disables DOCTYPE/external entities/DTD loading before builder creation; write-up notes this is safe for XML that needs no DTDs.

R155.note: Switching th:utext to th:text is the correct, minimal Thymeleaf fix; notes the sanitizer-library path if raw HTML is ever legitimately needed.
